### 2026-11-03: November 3rd: Mobi started

**4h**

November 3rd: Mobi started

Researched online what project I could make and wanted to make a robot. Inspired by the Sesame Robot that went viral for being easy to build.

![image](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/sessions/rsJwrjl25kbCfZE7Dltry86oScYzcoZw/42412e570bdb91813454c64071c720edb5ea2e630f916b39076462853f39cee3.png)

So I wanted to create something like that so I decided to make something like that. Two wheel robot that I could drive using a phone. So, I started by researching all the parts I need, and one of the main component I am using for the motor control is this.

![image](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/sessions/rsJwrjl25kbCfZE7Dltry86oScYzcoZw/ee7bd16b70fab7f45ee860d52d6b9ab841b2802cc64be30f54b5501742e636f5.png)

The others were minor things that I gotta finalize but I started the PCB schematic.
